description: Audit an arbitrary or hypothetical weekly lifting split across all 17 muscle groups using fractional set accounting (`1.0x` prime mover, `0.5x` synergist, `RPE >= 6` hard-set gate) against Schoenfeld & Pelland MEV/MAV/MRV landmarks. Stateless public calculator (no auth required). Use when passing movement-archetype set counts directly without an account; to check a signed-in athlete's saved STRUGGL ledger volume use `get_muscle_volume`, or use `interference_tax` for strength-plus-endurance timing conflicts.

entries.description: Weekly movement entries mapped to curated biomechanics archetypes.

archetype.description: Curated biomechanics movement pattern key defining primary and synergist muscles.

frequency_days.description: Distinct training days per week this movement pattern is performed (1–7).

rpe.description: Average set RPE (5.0–10.0; sets below RPE 6.0 are filtered out as warm-ups).

sets.description: Total weekly sets performed for this movement pattern (0–60).

name: volume_audit

app_url.description: Deep link to inspect this calculation interactively in STRUGGL.

connect_url.description: URL to connect a stateful STRUGGL athlete ledger via OAuth 2.1 or token.

effective_stimulus_pct.description: Percentage of volume landing inside productive hypertrophy bands.

junk_volume_pct.description: Percentage of volume lost to non-recoverable junk sets.

methodology.description: Peer-reviewed sports-science equation and STRUGGL pillar provenance.

muscles.description: Per-muscle 17-row breakdown with direct, synergist, MEV, MAV, and MRV numbers.

onboarding.description: OAuth 2.1 connector metadata explaining what longitudinal state unlocking adds.

optimal_muscles.description: Muscle groups inside optimal MAV hypertrophy landmarks.

overloaded_muscles.description: Muscle groups exceeding Maximum Recoverable Volume (MRV).

primary_anomaly_muscle.description: Highest-priority overloaded or undertrained muscle group.

primary_anomaly_summary.description: Diagnostic explanation of the primary volume imbalance.

recommendations.description: Concrete set-reallocation adjustments to bring muscles into MAV.

total_hard_sets.description: Total fractional prime+synergist sets clearing the RPE >= 6 gate.

total_junk_sets.description: Sets exceeding per-session or weekly MRV recovery ceilings.

total_raw_sets.description: Sum of raw weekly sets submitted across all archetypes.

undertrained_muscles.description: Muscle groups below Minimum Effective Volume (MEV).

title: 17-Muscle Fractional MEV/MAV/MRV Volume Audit
